# Monet Picker **Pick your Monet colours yourself instead of taking them from the wallpaper.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Pick Monet colours independently of the wallpaper - Ported from AOSP (DerpFest), with bug fixes and unused code removed - Android 12 through Android 16 - Works on OriginOS, ColorOS and similar OEM ROMs ## Requirements - Android 12 or newer - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Magisk Delta may not be compatible. - If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. ## Screenshots

Monet Picker

Pick your Monet colours yourself instead of taking them from the wallpaper.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Pick Monet colours independently of the wallpaper
  • Ported from AOSP (DerpFest), with bug fixes and unused code removed
  • Android 12 through Android 16
  • Works on OriginOS, ColorOS and similar OEM ROMs

    • Requirements

  • Android 12 or newer
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Monet-Picker/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Magisk Delta may not be compatible.
  • If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center.
